Vendored qrcode-terminal 0.12.0 from the npm installation bundled with Node.js on this machine. Source: https://github.com/gtanner/qrcode-terminal. QR engine: Kazuhiko Arase, MIT license (see vendor/QRCode/index.js). Package wrapper: Apache 2.0, original LICENSE retained. Only package metadata devDependencies/scripts were removed to support offline installation; algorithm source is unchanged. Used for ASCII, non-bank QR demo payloads.
